title: Gaggle
description: A siloed workforce within an instance (GAG-001..007).

apiVersion.description: API version of this gaggle definition.

metadata.description: Identity and optional labels or annotations for this gaggle.

spec.description: The gaggle's project, backlog, isolation boundary, and shared runner settings.

workbench.description: Source-owned backlog/objective workbench. Omission adds no reads or authority. Provider access requires explicit interactive policy.

sources.description: Bounded sources from this gaggle backlog and configured project/additional repositories.

items.description: A configured source within this gaggle. No arbitrary URL, credential, branch or cross-gaggle target is accepted.

kind.description: Existing backlog, literal Markdown files, or one relationship manifest.

repository.description: Qualified identity of an already configured gaggle code repository.

owner.description: GitHub owner or Azure DevOps organization.

project.description: Azure DevOps project; forbidden for GitHub.

paths.description: Literal repository-relative file paths, never globs or crawl roots.

items.description: One source file path; scope and extension are checked before use.

objectives.description: Explicit native objective selection. Any listed ID, type or label matches; no title inference.

ids.description: Stable provider object IDs within this backlog.

types.description: Exact provider item types, such as ADO Epic or Feature.

ids.description: Requires at least one explicitly selected ids.

types.description: Requires at least one explicitly selected types.

labels.description: Requires at least one explicitly selected labels.

writes.description: Additional source allowlist. Current human policy, credentials and actual operation support remain required.

fields.description: Fields permitted for this source; omission is read-only.

items.description: Supported source field. Documents accept only title/description; manifests none.

metadata.description: Source-owned identity operations allowed through reviewed PRs. Documents allow assign-objective; the owning relationship manifest allows aliases.

items.description: One explicitly permitted metadata operation, additionally restricted by source kind at validation.

relationships.description: Authored relationship kinds permitted for this source.

items.description: Canonical authored edge kind; run observations cannot be declared.

relationshipManifest.description: Declared relationships binding for new edges lacking faithful native or frontmatter representation; does not migrate existing ownership.

events.description: Gaggle-local subscriptions and explicit workflow publication permissions.

ingress.description: Explicit external producer identities, sources and event type ceilings.

issuer.description: Exact authenticated trust domain; internal goobers issuers are forbidden.

allowedTypes.description: Literal event types; wildcards are not interpreted.

publishers.description: Explicit publication permissions for workflows in this gaggle.

items.description: A workflow and its exact event type ceiling.

workflow.description: An existing workflow in this gaggle.

allowedTypes.description: Literal event types; wildcards are not interpreted.

subscriptions.description: Consumers whose matching configuration is pinned at event acceptance.

items.description: A consumer targeting an existing workflow within the same gaggle.

name.description: Consumer identity unique in this gaggle.

workflow.description: Name of an existing workflow in this gaggle.

filter.description: Require every all condition and at least one any condition when any is supplied.

items.description: A literal comparison on one CloudEvents envelope attribute.

not.description: Negate equality, including a missing optional attribute.

any.description: Alternatives of which at least one must match.

items.description: A literal comparison on one CloudEvents envelope attribute.

not.description: Negate equality, including a missing optional attribute.

debounce.description: Optional bounded grouping. Exactly one key source must be declared.

keyAttribute.description: Envelope attribute used for grouping; an absent value fails this delivery.

constantKey.description: Explicit constant key used for all matching events.

window.description: Trailing quiet period from 100ms to 5m; default 5s.

maxWait.description: Maximum group age, at least window and at most 1h; default 30s.

maxEvents.description: Close the group at this count; default 100.

inputMode.description: Payload selection; defaults to all while retaining every membership.

interactiveAccess.description: Explicit per-gaggle human operations policy. Omission enables no new provider reads, sessions or writes; existing monitoring is unchanged.

humans.description: Instance roles are necessary and explicit gaggle grants are also required, including for administrators.

items.description: Matches an authenticated issuer plus one stable subject or verified group.

issuer.description: Exact authenticated trust domain, normally the OIDC issuer URL.

subject.description: Exact stable authenticated subject; display names are not identifiers.

group.description: Exact verified group identifier from the configured OIDC groups claim.

operators.description: Human operators; also granted gaggle visibility.

items.description: Matches an authenticated issuer plus one stable subject or verified group.

issuer.description: Exact authenticated trust domain, normally the OIDC issuer URL.

subject.description: Exact stable authenticated subject; display names are not identifiers.

group.description: Exact verified group identifier from the configured OIDC groups claim.

actions.description: Closed operation allowlist; implementation support is checked separately.

credentials.description: Explicit named sources from instance.interactiveCredentials, with no automation or cross-target fallback.

backlog.description: Named credential bound to the configured singleton backlog.

repositories.description: Explicit credentials for configured project/additional repositories.

repository.description: Qualified identity of an already configured gaggle code repository.

owner.description: GitHub owner or Azure DevOps organization.

project.description: Azure DevOps project; forbidden for GitHub.

sourceWrites.description: Repository edits always require pull requests. Omission enforces the same rule.

displayName.description: Human-facing gaggle name shown in the portal.

cost.description: Overrides external cost publication without disabling local usage accounting.

enabled.description: Overrides instance cost.enabled when boolean; null or omitted inherits the instance default.

Selects whether new runs may start for this gaggle. Defaults to true; null or omitted means true (enabled). Setting false disables new run starts for this gaggle without changing its schedule or backlog configuration.

selfIdentity.description: Provider login used as this gaggle's self identity for assignment-aware backlog operations. Omitted inherits instance.yaml selfIdentity.

project.description: Primary code repository this gaggle works on.

backlog.description: Singleton source of work-item truth for this gaggle.

isolation.description: Per-gaggle namespace and workload-identity boundary. The active mode-3 worker routes every stage pod for this gaggle into its declared namespace and validates that namespace's existence and RBAC access before polling or dispatching (#4897); the quarantined operator also consumes this block for its own, separate reconcile path.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace this gaggle's stage pods are created in. The active mode-3 dispatcher routes each stage pod here from its Attempt's gaggle — never a worker-wide default — and refuses to start if the namespace does not exist or this worker's credentials lack the RBAC grants dispatch needs there (#4897). Two gaggles may declare the SAME namespace deliberately; that shared topology is supported.

serviceAccount.description: Stage pod ServiceAccount; defaults to goobers-stage. Set default explicitly to opt out. The account must exist and disable token automount.

identityRef.description: Target per-gaggle Azure workload identity for external services. The active dispatcher does not yet consume this declaration — isolation.serviceAccount independently selects the Kubernetes account; workload identity federation is tracked separately.

additionalRepos.description: Optional reference repositories supplied read-only to runs in addition to the primary project.

ciCommand.description: Per-gaggle local CI-equivalent command run by the deterministic local-ci stage instead of its declared default (MGV-1/#1009).

requiredCapabilities.description: Runner (toolchain/platform) capabilities every run of this gaggle needs, matched at schedule time against a runner's advertised set (RRQ-1/#1101). DSL ≤2.0 only: DSL 3.0 removes this field in favor of spec.runsOn (dsl-3.0.md D1/D12); the 3.0 interpreter refuses it with a pointer diagnostic.

runsOn.description: Gaggle-level placement floor (DSL 3.0 only, dsl-3.0.md §2): OS, toolchain capability tags, and required runner restrictions that merge into every stage of every workflow in this gaggle — capabilities and restrictions union with the stage's own; an OS conflict with a stage is a compile error. No quantities at gaggle level. Activates only for gaggles whose workflows pin DSL 3.0.

os.description: Operating system every stage of this gaggle requires — same validated enum as a stage's runsOn.os.

capabilities.description: Toolchain tags unioned into every stage's runsOn.capabilities (internal/runnercap grammar). os=* tokens are rejected (CAP004). maxItems bounds CRD CEL validation cost (#3168).

restrictions.description: Isolation effects unioned into every stage's runsOn.restrictions, from the closed v1 effect list (Goobernetes decision D7). Unknown tokens are rejected with a suggestion (CAP005). maxItems bounds CRD CEL validation cost (#3168).

branchNamespace.description: refs/heads/ root this gaggle's run branches live under (providers.BranchName). Empty defaults to 'goobers/'. A trailing slash is optional. Must be a valid ref-path segment sequence (#965/#1010).

runControls.description: Gaggle-level overrides for instance runner safety budgets.

outboxMirrorPath.description: Default absolute local filesystem root (or ~/ path) where workflows additionally mirror durable journal outbox files.

sandbox.description: Per-gaggle override of the instance-wide isolation posture for agentic stages (#1305). Omitted inherits the instance posture; the default is disabled (opt-in).

agentic.description: Isolation posture for agentic stages. Omitted inherits the instance posture.

workcopies.description: Per-gaggle override for managed working-copy placement. The gaggle name and repository key are appended beneath this base path.

root.description: Absolute base path for this gaggle's managed mirrors and worktrees. Overrides instance.yaml workcopies.root.

requireLabels.description: Default requireLabels value every workflow's backlog-query task in this gaggle inherits unless the task declares its own requireLabels input (full replace, not merge — same shape as branchNamespace/headPrefix) (MIRC-2, #1901).

issueOwnershipScope.description: Default ownership policy every workflow task in this gaggle inherits for provider-visible issue writes. A task may override it with ownershipAssignees and ownershipUnassigned inputs. Omitted leaves issue writes unrestricted.

assignees.description: Provider identities this gaggle may mutate. Empty means no assigned-owner restriction, though unassigned may still refuse unassigned issues.

unassigned.description: Whether unassigned issues are inside this gaggle's write scope. Empty behaves as allow when assignees is empty and refuse when assignees is set.

siblings.description: Other gaggles/instances known to independently work the same target repo, for the sibling-overlap validation warning (MIRC-2, #1901).

metadata.description: Deliberately left open (no additionalProperties:false) unlike the rest of this schema: k8s-style metadata objects tolerate forward-compatible extra fields (e.g. a future resourceVersion) by convention (#125).

name.description: DNS-label-compatible gaggle name, unique within the instance.

labels.description: String labels used to organize this gaggle.

annotations.description: Non-identifying string metadata attached to this gaggle.

repoRef.description: Provider-neutral reference to a git repository. It carries no credential; the token comes from the matching instance.yaml repos[] entry.

baseUrl.description: Forge root URL (e.g. https://gitea.example.com); required when provider is gitea, since self-hosted Gitea has no fixed host. Rejected when provider is github: GitHub Enterprise Server is unsupported, so a github reference always means github.com.

owner.description: GitHub organization or user, Gitea owner, or Azure DevOps organization.

project.description: Azure DevOps project. Omit for GitHub repositories.

branch.description: Default branch checked out by runs. Omitted defaults to main.

connectionRef.description: Name of a Manifest connection. Accepted but not yet used to source credentials (validate reports REF012): the token for this repository comes from instance.yaml repos[] and credentials[], with Key Vault tokens resolved through secretStores. Connection-level credentials are planned (docs/design/provider-access-layer.md).

checkout.description: Partial-checkout declaration (B2, #649). Accepted but not honored by the local runner yet — inert, surfaced as a VER003 compatibility warning at validate time.

sparse.description: Repo-relative path cones a sparse checkout materializes. Empty means a full checkout.

gaggleSibling.description: Another gaggle/instance known to independently work the same target repo — identified by target repo, never by gaggle name (MIRC-2, #1901).

project.description: Repo the sibling gaggle targets — the sole match key (provider/owner/name).

label.description: Human-readable name for the sibling, used only in warning messages.

requireLabels.description: This gaggle's own trusted declaration of the sibling's effective required-label scope.

runnerCapability.description: A free-form, version-parameterized runner capability token (e.g. dotnet@8, xcode, os=windows) — distinct from a credential capability. An alphanumeric start then letters, digits, and any of . _ - + @ =, no whitespace.

runControls.description: Runner-level safety budgets inherited by this gaggle's workflows. Omitted fields retain instance defaults.

maxRepasses.description: Maximum number of times gates may cumulatively route a run back to the same already-completed stage before escalation, regardless of gate or outcome.

stalledRunTimeout.description: Maximum journal-silent period before watchdog escalation, expressed as a Go duration.

maxRunDuration.description: Maximum total wall-clock age of a run, expressed as a Go duration. Omit to disable.

backlogRef.description: Provider-neutral reference to the singleton backlog a gaggle draws work from.

baseUrl.description: Forge root URL (e.g. https://gitea.example.com); required when provider is gitea, since self-hosted Gitea has no fixed host. Rejected when provider is github: GitHub Enterprise Server is unsupported, so a github reference always means github.com.

project.description: GitHub owner/repository or Azure DevOps project that scopes the backlog.

labels.description: Required labels used to narrow candidate work items.

labelPredicate.description: CEL label-set predicate using only string membership in `labels` and boolean &&, ||, and !. ANDed with labels.

fieldPredicate.description: CEL predicate over the provider's typed native-field projection. ANDed with labels; unavailable fields are errors.

connectionRef.description: Name of a Manifest connection. Accepted but not yet used to source credentials (validate reports REF012): backlog access uses the same instance.yaml repos[]/credentials[] credential as the rest of the gaggle, with Key Vault tokens resolved through secretStores. Connection-level credentials are planned (docs/design/provider-access-layer.md).

doneStates.description: Work-item states that count as done when deciding whether a linked predecessor still blocks its successor. Read for an Azure DevOps backlog only; GitHub and Gitea accept it and ignore it. Omitted means the Resolved, Completed and Removed state categories count as done.

categories.description: Azure DevOps state categories that count as done for any work item type not listed in byType. Omitted or empty means Resolved, Completed and Removed.

byType.description: Per work item type name, the state names that count as done for that type. A listed type ignores categories.
